definitions.explanation: Suffix attached to time expressions to indicate an approximate time. Can also be written as 〜頃 (ごろ with voiced consonant). Indicates 'around' or 'about' a certain time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ころ、⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んだ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: When I was a child, I often played in the park.

examples.japanese: ⟦いつ→いつ：00536_itsu⟧ごろ⟦{届|とど}きますか→届く：00899_todoku⟧。

⟦{六|ろく}→六：00747_roku⟧⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧ごろ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{夕|ゆう}ごはん→夕ご飯：27817_yuugohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}って→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦おいて→置く：01092_oku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: I'll be home around 6, so please have dinner ready.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ころ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んで→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦{思|おも}うと→思う：00492_omou⟧、⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧ころ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{楽|たの}しかった→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧。
examples.english: When I was a child, I played with friends every day. Looking back now, those were the most fun times.

notes:
PRONUNCIATION: Usually voiced as ごろ after most words, but ころ in some expressions like ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ころ.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{何|なん}→何：noentry⟧⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧ごろ (around what time)
- ⟦いつ→いつ：00536_itsu⟧ごろ (around when)
- ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧ごろ (around now, by now)
- ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧ころ (around that time, those days)
- ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧ころ (around that time)
- ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ころ (when [I was] a child)
- ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ころ (in the old days)

NOTE: Different from ⟦くらい→ぐらい：02900_gurai⟧/⟦ぐらい→ぐらい：02900_gurai⟧ which indicates approximate quantity or extent, not specifically time. 〜ごろ is specifically for time.
